Patil R

   📱 (+91) 8390335578 |   prupesh297@gmail.com |  https://www.linkedin.com/in/rupesh-patil-5b6047158/ 

Professional Summary

Senior Software Engineer | 7.6 years of experience | Individual Contributor

Strong domain experience in Banking, Legal, Finance, and E-Commerce

Strong expertise in Core Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Spring MVC, Spring IOC, JPA, Spring Security and Design Pattern.

Hands-on experience with REST and SOAP web services.

Knowledge of AWS cloud services and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

Solid understanding of CQRS pattern, Circuit Breaker Pattern, and API Gateway pattern in microservices architecture.

Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for CI/CD and application lifecycle management

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, adaptable to new technologies

Effective team player with experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies

Technical Proficiencies 

Programming: Core Java 8/11/17/21, J2EE, Servlet, JSP

Microservices/Web Services: Microservices, RESTful, SOAP, Graph-QL

Frameworks/Tools: Spring-Boot, Spring-IOC, Spring-MVC, Spring Security, JPA, Hibernate, Collection, Junit, Mockito

Databases/ORM: Oracle, MySQL, Rocks DB, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate

Cloud/DevOps: Azure (ADO), Apache Tomcat, AWS, GIT, SVN, TFS, Apache Maven, Gradle, Jenkins

Testing/Monitoring: Junit Mockito, Postman, Swagger, SOAP UI, Fiddler, Datadog

Scripting/Frontend: Angular, JavaScript, jQuery, Ajax.

Messaging & Streaming: Kafka (working knowledge, POCs, event-driven design)

Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM – working knowledge)

AI Agents: GitHub Copilot

IDE Tools: IntelliJ, Eclipse, STS, MS Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, My Eclipse 5.1

Professional Experience

   Epam Systems, Pune | Key Developer | July 2022 – Present

Westlaw Global (Thomson Reuters - Legal Domain): Designed & developed scalable microservices for document ingestion, metadata extraction and enrichment

Successfully implemented Microservices Architecture utilizing design patterns like CQRS, API Gateway & Circuit Breaker for application.

Designed, developed, tested, and documented application functionalities using Microservices, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Java 17/21, JPA, Rocks DB, Easel, Fiddler, Azure ADO.

Designed CQRS-based read models using Search and PostgreSQL views to support high-performance legal search and dashboards

Implemented access control logic using OAuth2, RBAC, and document-level entitlements.

Improved performance by implementing idempotency, connection pooling, caching and batching.

Developed RESTful web services using the Spring framework, JPA to facilitate seamless application integration and functionality.

Ensured clean and maintainable code by applying SOLID, KISS, DRY, and core OOP principles, resulting in improved readability, reduced complexity, and easier enhancements.



Implemented and maintained Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated builds, deployments, code coverage validation, and continuous quality checks by integrating code smell, bug detection, and static analysis tools

Participated in all Agile SCRUM ceremonies such as Sprint Planning, Refinement, Reviews, and Retrospectives, promoting effective collaboration, continuous feedback, and process improvement.

   Epam Systems, Pune | Key Developer | March 2021 – June 2022

CS Professional Suite (Thomson Reuters Tax and Accounting): Successfully implemented Microservices Architecture utilizing design patterns like API Gateway and Circuit Breaker for its multiple application.

Collaborated on developing RESTful web services and supporting system maintenance using Java 8/11, Spring Boot, JPA.

Developed unit tests for backend services using JUnit and Mockito, ensuring high code coverage.

   Zensar Technology | Software Engineer | Feb 2019 – Feb 2021

DXP (Digital Experience Platform MasterCard E-Commerce/Finance): Worked on multiple components of DXP Microservices with Spring Boot and implemented DAO classes using JPA Hibernate with Oracle RDBMS.

Designing Controller, Service, Utility and DAO specific Java Classes of multiple components.

Enforced Code Quality standards using SonarQube, addressing code smells, vulnerabilities, and duplication issues.

   Zensar Technology | Software Engineer | Oct 2018 – Jan 2019

Supplier Connection Workbench (SCW - Cisco): Developed code and implemented DAO classes for interaction with Oracle RDBMS using Spring Boot, Microservices, and JPA Hibernate.

Designed and developed controllers, services, and DAO layers, implementing business requirements with efficient database interactions, along with unit testing, bug fixing, and requirement analysis.

   Zensar Technology |Software Engineer | May 2018 – Oct 2018

PRRQ (Cisco): Performed end-to-end requirement analysis, design, development, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer while building RESTful services using Spring Boot and integrating them with Angular 5 components.

Implemented Hibernate ORM for database operations, created mappings, and ensured seamless communication between components through observables and component interaction patterns.

Awards and Recognition

‘Pat on Back’ Award for best contribution in the project.

‘ENGX DOJO winner’ Award for winning a coding competition in EPAM.

‘NAFS Tech Expert’ Award for conducting technical sessions on Swagger Codegen.

The POC showcased several caching strategies designed to enhance application performance, scalability, and response time.

The Redis Cache demonstration highlighted its seamless integration within our microservices architecture and its potential to significantly improve efficiency.

I am honoured to have received appreciation from the client for this effort and am grateful for the opportunity to contribute to this impactful initiative.

Education and Certifications

BE (IT) - from Dr D. Y. Patil College of Engineering, Pune.

Certification from PROFOUND Institute Pune in Java Language.
